issues.title: Verify the Google programs for NW Kids from the official pages
issues.body:
Turn the UNVERIFIED table in impact/LANE.md into verified facts: for Google for Nonprofits, Ad Grants, Workspace for Nonprofits, YouTube Nonprofit Program and Google Business Profile, record eligibility, what NW Kids gets, the steps, and the official link for each claim (read the pages; no account actions).

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at impact/nwkids/google-programs.md, each fact with its URL and the date read. Research only.

issues.title: NW Kids Google readiness checklist (profile + Ad Grants)
issues.body:
Using the verified program facts and the impact knowledge (cause-specialist: funders check online visibility first, NVJyUFfRQtM), draft the checklist NW Kids must meet: 501(c)(3) documents, Google for Nonprofits validation, Business Profile verification, website requirements for Ad Grants, conversion tracking. Mark each item have / missing / unknown from nwkids.org.

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at impact/nwkids/google-readiness.md. Draft only; nothing is created or submitted.

issues.title: Draft the NW Kids Google Business Profile copy
issues.body:
From nwkids.org and the owner's notes, draft the profile: name, category options, description (750 chars), services, first 3 posts, and the photo list we need from the organized Drive media. Facts only from the site or the owner.

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at impact/nwkids/google-profile-draft.md. Draft only.

issues.title: Find the 10 easiest grants NW Kids qualifies for this quarter
issues.body:
Research grants for a Seattle-area youth nonprofit (mentoring, keeping kids out of trouble). For each: funder, amount, deadline, eligibility, effort (low/med/high), link. Rank by fit and effort. Use the impact knowledge on where small nonprofits should look (cause-specialist iJgi48rlgNA).

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at impact/nwkids/grant-shortlist.md. Research only; nothing is applied for.

issues.title: Smart-site factory: write the HVAC demo spec from the Jasper logic
issues.body:
Turn the Jasper smart-site flow A-C (form -> durable lead -> private operator view) into a buildable spec for a reusable HVAC demo (Modern Air), with the owner's prices ($1,950 setup, $197 care) as the offer. Knowledge: jasper-smart-sites (on the NEW box), mozi-sales offers.

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at districts/production/specs/hvac-smart-site.md with acceptance tests. Spec only.

issues.title: Brownfield inspection: allweather roofing and GOAT alliance repos
issues.body:
Read-only inspection of the roofing site and executiveusa/goatalliance: what exists, what runs, tests, deploy target, blast radius, and the smallest slice that makes each a working smart site. No changes.

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at districts/production/inspections/<repo>.md each.

issues.title: Freedom of Speech store: niche and demand research for the owner's category decision
issues.body:
The store cannot add categories (its constitution); the owner decides (freedomofspeech decisions/0009). Prepare the decision: 10 candidate free-speech niches with demand signals, competition, legal-line risk notes and 3 original design directions each. Use commerce knowledge (mozi-sales offers, metricsmule-video UGC ads).

Deliver: the result text (posted on this issue by Heisenberg). After independent review it is filed at districts/commerce/research/niche-options.md. Research only; no designs published, no listings.
